results.content: Make a deeper commitment to yourself and to your practice with the transformative, rewarding, and longest-running Yoga Teacher Training program in the area. Registration is OPEN for our cornerstone programs beginning in January 2027 at the Yoga Center of Columbia: RYT 200 Yoga Teacher Training & RYT 500 Yoga Teacher Training! [...] Elevate your yoga practice and become a certified yoga teacher with the prestigious 11-month RYT 200 Yoga Teacher Training program taught by Kelly and Lucy. Our Yoga Alliance and American Yoga Council-registered training program deepens your knowledge of yoga’s fundamentals, philosophy, and teaching techniques: perfect for those wanting to teach or enrich their personal practice. Save $200 when you register by December 15th! [...] Or for yoga teachers seeking to expand your yoga teaching toolbox, join lead teacher Jen with other experienced YCC faculty and notable guest instructors for the RYT 500 Yoga Teacher Training program! Enrich your practice and pedagogy by delving deeper into asana practice, pranayama, meditation, yogic culture, philosophy, and much, much more. Save $200 when you register by December 1st!
